scripts.build: npm run build -w admiralty-gate && npm run build -w @admiralty-gate/server && npm run build -w @admiralty-gate/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w admiralty-gate && npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @admiralty-gate/server && npm run typecheck -w @admiralty-gate/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @admiralty-gate/server" "npm run dev -w @admiralty-gate/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @admiralty-gate/server" "npm run start -w @admiralty-gate/web"
